summary: Verified JWT authentication and Paper Trading features - All 14 backend tests passed. JWT login returns valid tokens, protected endpoints work with Bearer tokens, paper trading status includes unrealized_pnl, combined_pnl, deployed_capital, and full config object.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT authentication implemented correctly with /api/auth/login/json endpoint returning access_token, token_type, expires_in, and user object
Dual-auth support working - both JWT Bearer tokens and HTTP Basic Auth accepted for protected endpoints
Paper trading status includes all required fields: unrealized_pnl, combined_pnl, deployed_capital, and config object
Config object in status contains: capital_deployment_pct, max_position_size_pct, max_position_size, kelly_fraction, max_drawdown_pct, trades_per_10min
Paper trader loads ALL config params from DB via _load_user_config() method (lines 132-166)
Position sizing correctly uses deployed_capital (capital_deployment_pct % of initial) - see _calculate_position_size() lines 614-648
/api/config/update endpoint persists all trading params to DB via user_config collection
seed_data_creation: Started and stopped paper trading sessions during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: JWT authentication and Paper Trading features verified. Key findings: 1) POST /api/auth/login/json returns valid JWT token with user object. 2) Protected endpoints accept Bearer token in Authorization header. 3) Dual-auth support: JWT preferred, Basic Auth fallback. 4) Paper trading status includes unrealized_pnl, combined_pnl (total+unrealized), deployed_capital. 5) Status includes full config object with capital_deployment_pct, max_position_size_pct, kelly_fraction, max_drawdown_pct, trades_per_10min. 6) /api/config/update persists all params to DB. 7) Paper trader loads config from DB on session start.

jwt_login_json.notes: Returns access_token, token_type='bearer', expires_in, user object with username/is_admin

jwt_protected_endpoints.notes: Protected endpoints correctly require authentication, accept JWT Bearer tokens

dual_auth_support.notes: Both JWT Bearer tokens and HTTP Basic Auth work for protected endpoints

paper_status_unrealized_pnl.notes: Status includes unrealized_pnl field for open positions

paper_status_config_object.notes: Status includes config object with all trading parameters

config_update_persistence.notes: Config update saves all params to DB user_config collection

paper_trades_endpoint.notes: Returns valid JSON without MongoDB _id errors
